text:
liz_marketing: Need to lock HarborCare case story timeline: interview, quote selection, legal sign-off, and webinar tie-in. Target publish alongside webinar in 10 days.

 tom_csm: Customer prefers Fri 10am PT. They can share a short demo clip and a usage metric slide.

 liz_marketing: Fri 10am PT works. I'll book 30m + 10m pre-brief. Ask them for headshot and logo assets.

 frank_prod: If they mention latency or throughput, use vetted language from infra. Don't publish raw p99 unless legal has logs. I'll paste the approved phrasing in a sec.

 jess_legal: Legal checklist: countersigned release, attach benchmark docs, and written approval of final quotes. We need the signed release before publish.

 tom_csm: Adding release to calendar invite and asking for countersign pre-call.

 frank_prod: Approved phrasing: "In our tests, Redwood Dedicated measured a 2.8x improvement in end-to-end inference p99 latency for HarborCare's recommendation pipeline."

 jess_legal: That wording is acceptable pending attachments. Suggest swapping "measured" to "recorded" if they insist on first-person phrasing.

 liz_marketing: Noted. Producer pre-brief at 9:50 PT. I'll bring hero quote prompts: impact statement, product reason, and measurable outcome.

 asset-bot: Reminder: after upload, tag assets with #harborcare-case and set retention=90d.

 tom_csm: Invite confirmed; release countersigned by anna@harborcare.io.

 liz_marketing: Next steps: 1) pre-brief 9:50 (liz) 2) interview Fri 10 (liz/tom) 3) capture hero + 2 bullets (frank) 4) drop transcript for legal review (jess) 5) upload assets & set embargo 48h (liz).

 jess_legal: I'll review quotes after transcript upload. Ping me here when done.

 liz_marketing: I'll post two hero variants in-thread within 24h of call. If anyone wants to propose phrasing now, drop it. :thumbsup:
